limitations.note: The patch fixed the premature assertion by registering `valid_b`, but it also made `ready_a` high during reset and before the first post-reset clock edge, and suppressed `valid_b` on stalled cycles at count five; the reference fix preserves the registered `ready_a` and samples `cnt == 5` without gating it on `valid_a`.

The test expected `ready_a` to be high during reset and expected `valid_b` only when a sixth bit was accepted, so its reset and stall checks validated the rewrite’s assumptions rather than detecting the behavioral mismatches.
